purpose: Unchanged pre-yield direct CURRENT transfer control: the later by-reference yield reads the live global after Fiber resume.
source:
<?php
function &Work59Fresh() {
    global $slot;
    echo 'ENTER|';
    $reply = Fiber::suspend('pause59');
    echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === 'go59'), '|';
    yield $slot;
    echo 'END|';
    return 59;
}
$slot = 'first59';
$g = Work59Fresh();
$f = new Fiber(function () use ($g) {
    echo 'CALL|';
    return $g->current();
});
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause59'), '|';
$slot = 'second59';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume('go59') === null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'second59'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 59), '|';
unset($f, $g, $slot);
echo 'E';

purpose: An old reference cache survives parked NEXT; current reads the live array while a prior by-value copy keeps its old object and COW lifetime.
source:
<?php
class Old59 { public function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; } }
class New59 { public function __destruct() { echo 'NEW|'; } }
function &Work59Array() {
    global $slot;
    echo 'SEED|';
    yield $slot;
    echo 'BODY|';
    $reply = Fiber::suspend('pause59');
    echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === 'go59'), '|';
    yield $slot;
    echo 'END|';
    return 59;
}
$slot = [new Old59()];
$g = Work59Array();
$copy = $g->current();
echo 'PRIME|', (int) ($copy[0] === $slot[0]), '|';
$f = new Fiber(function () use ($g) {
    echo 'CALL|';
    $g->next();
    echo 'AFTER|';
    return $g->current();
});
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause59'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|';
$slot[0] = new New59();
echo 'LIVE|', (int) ($g->current()[0] === $slot[0]), '|', (int) ($copy[0] instanceof Old59), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume('go59') === null), '|';
echo 'RESULT|', (int) ($f->getReturn()[0] === $slot[0]), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 59), '|';
unset($copy);
echo 'COPY-DROP|';
unset($f, $g, $slot);
echo 'E';

purpose: A parameter and cache retain the original reference cell after the external variable name is rebound to a different cell.
source:
<?php
function &Work59Rebind(&$cell) {
    echo 'SEED|';
    yield $cell;
    echo 'BODY|';
    $reply = Fiber::suspend('pause59');
    echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === 'go59'), '|';
    yield $cell;
    echo 'END|';
    return 59;
}
$slot = 5;
$old =& $slot;
$g = Work59Rebind($slot);
echo 'PRIME|', (int) ($g->current() === 5), '|';
$f = new Fiber(function () use ($g) {
    echo 'CALL|';
    $g->next();
    echo 'AFTER|';
    return $g->current();
});
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause59'), '|';
$replacement = 9;
$slot =& $replacement;
$old = 7;
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|';
echo 'CELLS|', (int) ($g->current() === 7), '|', (int) ($slot === 9), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume('go59') === null), '|';
echo 'RESULT|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 7), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 59), '|';
unset($f, $g, $slot, $old, $replacement);
echo 'E';

purpose: A supplied Exception traverses the parked Generator and finally; the closed reference cache owns its object after the global is unset.
source:
<?php
class Token59 { public function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
function &Work59Throw() {
    global $slot, $given;
    try {
        echo 'SEED|';
        yield $slot;
        echo 'BODY|';
        Fiber::suspend('pause59');
        echo 'BAD-BODY|';
        yield $slot;
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $given), '|';
        throw $caught;
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|';
    }
}
$slot = new Token59();
$weak = WeakReference::create($slot);
$g = Work59Throw();
$g->current();
$f = new Fiber(function () use ($g) { echo 'CALL|'; $g->next(); echo 'BAD-CALL|'; });
$given = new Exception('injected59');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause59'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|', (int) ($g->current() === $slot), '|';
try {
    $f->throw($given);
    echo 'BAD-RETURN|';
} catch (Exception $outside) {
    echo 'OUTSIDE|', (int) ($outside === $given), '|', (int) ($outside->getPrevious() === null), '|';
}
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) $f->isTerminated(), '|';
unset($slot);
echo 'SLOT-DROP|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $outside, $given);
echo 'CACHE-DROP|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
unset($weak);
echo 'E';

purpose: A cached cell alone owns its object while NEXT is parked; outside NEXT gets one Error with no Previous, and the next yield releases the object before caller continuation.
source:
<?php
class Sole59 { public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP|'; } }
function &SoleCache59() {
    $value = new Sole59();
    echo 'SEED|';
    yield $value;
    unset($value);
    echo 'BODY|';
    Fiber::suspend('pause59');
    echo 'RESUMED|';
    $next = null;
    yield $next;
    echo 'TAIL|';
}
$g = SoleCache59();
$copy = $g->current();
$weak = WeakReference::create($copy);
unset($copy);
$f = new Fiber(function () use ($g) {
    echo 'CALL|';
    $g->next();
    echo 'AFTER|';
});
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause59'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
try {
    $g->next();
    echo 'BAD-REENTRY|';
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo 'ERROR|', (int) ($error->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'),
         '|', (int) ($error->getPrevious() === null), '|';
}
echo 'STILL|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'RELEASED|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'END|', (int) !$g->valid(), '|';
unset($g, $f, $weak, $error);
echo 'E';
